identityScope: Four catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against current Roborock US shop pages. Saros Z70, Q5 Max+, Q10 S5+ and S7 Max Ultra are four separate current models. The Q8 Max+ page was excluded because it states the product has not been launched yet, and the Qrevo Master URL redirects to a different Qrevo S5V model. The reviewed pages publish current US prices, so the catalog 2599, ~330, ~280 and 1299 USD values are replaced. The Saros Z70 page publishes only a 38.14 lbs robot-plus-dock weight, so the catalog ~4.5 kg mass is cleared; the page dimension text prints 133.89 in for the second figure, an evident typo for 13.89 in. The Saros Z70 runtime is about 135 min with the robotic arm disabled, and the catalog 180 min runtime and ~3 hours battery label are replaced by that statement and the 6,400 mAh capacity. The Q10 S5+ catalog 350 min battery and runtime labels are replaced by 5,200 mAh and up to 150 min. The S7 Max Ultra page publishes no full-charge runtime, so the catalog 180 min battery and runtime labels are replaced by 5,200 mAh and a cleared runtime. No new model was created and no company focus was added.

companyFocus.name: Roborock
companyFocus.role: Consumer cleaning and floor-care robot manufacturer
companyFocus.reviewNotes: Batch165. Roborock pages read as text only; no research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. Saros 10, Qrevo Edge, Qrevo Slim and Saros 10R are four separate current models. No login, forms, contact, messages or transactions. All USPs, complete portfolios and leadership remain unproven.
highlights: Roborock is a consumer cleaning and floor-care robot manufacturer whose reviewed US range includes the Saros 10, Saros 10R, Qrevo Edge and Qrevo Slim.
The reviewed pages publish 11,000 Pa suction for the Qrevo Slim, 18,500 Pa for the Qrevo Edge and 22,000 Pa for the Saros 10, with HyperForce and dual anti-tangle brush systems.
Battery capacity is 5,200 mAh for the Qrevo Slim and 6,400 mAh for the Saros 10, Qrevo Edge and Saros 10R; the Saros 10 and Saros 10R pages cite 2.5-hour fast charging.
The Saros 10 page publishes 52 dB(A) in quiet mopping and 72 dB(A) dock self-emptying, and the Qrevo Edge page 55 dB mopping with 75 C mop washing.
The reviewed pages publish no full-charge runtime, payload or IP rating; robot mass figures of 8.6, 9.04 and 36.38 lbs remain separate from the catalog values.
